# visudo
%sysadmins ALL=(ALL) ALL
appsvc ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart meridian-app
Defaults requiretty
Defaults log_input,log_output
caption: appsvc can restart its own service, nothing else — and every sudo session now logs its input and output.

code:
# /etc/ssh/sshd_config
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
AllowUsers deploy sysadmin

# /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
[sshd]
maxretry = 4
bantime = 1h
findtime = 10m
caption: Key-only login, a short allow-list of users, and a ban for anyone who keeps guessing.

eyebrow: Rules an auditor will actually ask about
